items.title: DexCom (DXCM) Stock Looks Undervalued On Fair Value While Earnings Look Fair
items.summary: DexCom stock has delivered a mixed ride for long term holders, with the share price down about 35.1% over five years even as a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to an intrinsic value that sits meaningfully above the current market price.
